title: X_eTaL-video lesson
description: A lesson as data (docs/plan.md V3): lessons/<slug>/lesson.json. Checked by scripts/check-schema.mjs, which reads the keywords used here and no others.

slug.description: The lesson's directory name under lessons/.

summary.description: One or two sentences for the landing page.

order.description: Where the lesson comes on the landing page (lower first).

poster.description: The frame used as the lesson's thumbnail (its middle if not given).

youtube.description: The video's YouTube id, once the user has uploaded it (just link SLUG URL); the site embeds it. Videos are hosted on YouTube, never in git.

stepFrames.description: The frames a stepping board holds each step (15 if not given).

demo.description: The live demo the lesson is about, if any.

seconds.description: The scene's length; with narration, the audio's length replaces it.

narration.description: What is spoken over the scene (at most 320 characters). A word said two ways is marked {written|spoken}: {read|red} shows read and says red; {live|live} keeps the usual reading (just voice --check requires a decision on every one).

curves.description: Show the three easing curves as moving dots.

capture.description: Show the recording of the lesson's demo page (scripts/capture.mjs) instead of lines. Scenes with a capture follow one another and are one recording; a scene's actions run when it starts.

scroll.description: A selector to bring to the top, or 'top'.

select.description: A select's selector, then the option's label.

boards.description: Arrays drawn as grids under the lines, each one printed by the lesson's data.xtl after a '== name' line.

numbers.description: Write each cell's number in it.

heat.description: Color each cell by its number, cells touching: 'ramp' from the least to the most; 'escape' for counts of steps, the cells that have never left (as many steps as there have been) black.

points.description: The array is positions, each board 2 by N (the x row, the y row): draw the N bodies, and with animate their trails.

animate.description: A list of boards shown one at a time, a step each; otherwise all at once, side by side.

lines.description: Text, X_eTaL as {"xtl": ...}, or other code (JSON, shell, a link) as {"code": ...}. {{f}}, {{scene}}, {{local}}, {{progress}}, {{total}}, {{secs}}, {{durs}} and {{starts}} and {{step}} are replaced by the frame's own numbers.

xtl.description: A line of X_eTaL, as typed; shown as the pinned xetal renders it (decorated, colored), never as typed.
